page_title: BAY 3-0 AUG | Bayern Munich v Augsburg 22/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' 3 - 0 It's a goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) gets on the end of a pass and it allows him to finish into an empty net with a close-range header. The score has changed to 3:0.
90+4' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich) for Alphonso Davies.
90+3' 2 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) slams home the penalty with a precise low shot into the bottom left corner.
90+3' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
90+3' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) makes a bad challenge and is given a second yellow card which means he's off.
90+3' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Bayern Munich!
90+1' Referee Daniel Schlager makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bayern Munich. Let’s see what happens!
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' PENALTY APPEAL after Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
88' Jamal Musiala comes off the pitch to be replaced by Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich).

88' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
87' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
85' The ball goes out of play. Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
85' Bayern Munich take a short corner kick.
85' Bayern Munich are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
83' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) picks up a pass on the edge of the box and manages to get a powerful shot away, forcing the goalkeeper to scramble to his left and palm the ball away.
81' Bayern Munich seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
78' Jess Thorup has decided to make a change. Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) replaces Alexis Claude-Maurice.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Marius Wolf walks off the pitch to be replaced by Henri Koudossou (Augsburg).
78' Dangerous play by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich). Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Today's match ends for Raphael Guerreiro who will be replaced by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
76' Vincent Kompany prepares a substitution. Kingsley Coman is replaced by Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) comes onto the pitch so that Michael Olise can be given a rest.
74' The statistic for corner kicks – 6:0.

73' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.

71' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar! The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
71' Wonderful movement by Bayern Munich. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
69' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Phillip Tietz will be replaced by Samuel Essende (Augsburg).
69' Substitution. Arne Maier is replaced by Mert Komur (Augsburg).
67' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Nediljko Labrovic.
66' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) plants a goal-bound header towards the left post after a nice cross inside the box, but one of the defenders manages to deflect it away.
65' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

65' Bayern Munich slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
63' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) into the top right hand corner, giving goalkeeper Nediljko Labrovic no chance!
63' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is going to take the penalty!
62' Referee Daniel Schlager is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Bayern Munich!

61' There's a break in play and referee Daniel Schlager must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bayern Munich using VAR. This could be interesting!
61' That looked a certain handball by Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
61' None of the Bayern Munich players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

60' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Bayern Munich will take a corner.
59' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayern Munich, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) is penalised for holding. Daniel Schlager signals a set piece. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Bayern Munich.
58' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
57' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.
57' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.

55' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though it was aimed precisely low towards the middle of the goal, Nediljko Labrovic didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
53' Bayern Munich can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
53' Bayern Munich are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.

51' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) receives a clever pass and shoots from mid-range. His shot looks like it's going into the roof of the net, but Nediljko Labrovic has other ideas and makes a brilliant save.
49' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
49' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
48' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayern Munich, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is out of play and Bayern Munich manage to earn a corner.
47' Daniel Schlager shows the yellow card to Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) for a heavy challenge.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Nediljko Labrovic (Augsburg) leaps to collect the ball.

45+3' Nediljko Labrovic leaps like a salmon to deny Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich), whose effort is headed to the underside of the crossbar, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net. Corner kick. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity.
45+2' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
43' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Nediljko Labrovic, who smothers the ball.
42' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Jamal Musiala.
41' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) attempts to score from a mid-range free kick, but he curls his effort a few inches over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
40' Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniel Schlager interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Bayern Munich have a free kick from a promising distance.
38' Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) comes onto the pitch because Dimitrios Giannoulis simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
36' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

34' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the left post, but Nediljko Labrovic shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
33' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Augsburg, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
32' Bayern Munich exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.

31' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Bayern Munich are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

28' Nediljko Labrovic was forced into action to thwart Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
25' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header directed into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop his effort.
24' Nediljko Labrovic blocks a long-range effort from Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) towards the right side of the goal.
21' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Nediljko Labrovic intercepts the ball.

20' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.

18' Ambitious effort from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.

15' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is out of play. Augsburg will take a throw-in.
14' Bayern Munich work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

13' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.

13' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
11' Kingsley Coman (Bayern Munich) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
10' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
8' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) plays a one-two with Kingsley Coman, but the move breaks down.
6' Bayern Munich are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in.
4' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
3' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Augsburg.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Augsburg will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Daniel Schlager.
